title: JFK visits Los Alamos a month after Malmgren's debrief
summary: Jesse Michels tells of JFK visits Los Alamos a month after Malmgren's debrief, about 1962 at Mexico (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: director and then a month later you have JFK come out himself. And so that's not really that normal for for JFK to come just check on this
Just just to back up. So, you go out to Los Alamos, you get briefed, you meet Lawrence Keys, and like literally a couple of weeks later, suddenly JFK, LBJ, and their teams are going to Los Alamos.
tellings.difference: Adds LBJ and their teams, says it was a couple of weeks later instead of a month, and is told by Pippa Malmgren.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of JFK visiting Los Alamos shortly after Malmgren's briefing there with Gise.

as_told.title: JFK and LBJ visit Los Alamos weeks after Malmgren's briefing
